comment: GHSA-rh54-8fpg-8wwf node vector corpus: every case verified against bitcoin-sv (GoBDK) while fixing the advisory.
valid/nodeError are bitcoin-sv 879fc8b42's verdict (gobdk v1.2.4 TxValidator.VerifyScriptWithCustomFlags(EF tx, coinHeights, spend, consensus, [word per input])).
word is the node's per-input script-verify flag word; consensus is false for words carrying a policy-only bit (NULLDUMMY, MINIMALDATA, DISCOURAGE_UPGRADABLE_NOPS, CLEANSTACK).
sats are the spent outputs' values; heavy vectors are slow on one side and skipped under -short.
rnd/* are random differential-batch cases on which the interpreter panicked before the top-level OP_RETURN end-of-script fix.
Skipped (over 100,000 hex chars): policy: 500,001-byte locking script, relay vs block word (1000124 hex chars)
